title: Masson Mills WTM 12b Power Loom 5877
description:
Masson Mills built in 1783 is home to a working textile mills. There is a small weaving shed with working looms some dating back to before 1867.

Power Loom referred to here as a Yorkshire Loom. It has a longer reedspace than the Lancashire Loom so can weave wider fabric.
author: Clem Rutter, Rochester, Kent.
